e: Austria prevents the head of the Atomic Energy Organization of Iran, Mohammad Eslami, from attending the IAEA's annual conference in Vienna due to US opposition, citing its sanctions against him.
A 673-piece platinum and diamond necklace previously worn by former Egyptian queen Nazli Sabri is stolen following a heist at the Museum of Applied Arts, Vienna.
A magnitude 4.2 earthquake hits Lower Austria, damaging 35 buildings.
A court in Canada convicts Magna International founder Frank Stronach of sexual assault and indecent assault for incidents that happened between the 1970s and 1990s.

Austria participates at the 2026 FIFA World Cup, finishing in the Round of 32 with a 0-3 loss against Spain at SoFi Stadium in Los Angeles. This is the first World Cup Austria participates in since 1998.
Austria is elected to a rotating seat at the United Nations Security Council.
Austria expels three staff of the Russian embassy in Vienna on charges of spying.
A 21-year old defendant pleads guilty before a court in Vienna on charges of participating in the 2024 Vienna terrorism plot. He is sentenced to 15 years' imprisonment on 28 May.
Hipp Holding orders a recall of its baby food products in Austria following the discovery of a tampered product believed to have been deliberately laced with rat poison in Burgenland.
Austria denies U.S. aircraft use of its ‌airspace for military operations against Iran.
Five people are killed in Linz and Tyrol following adverse conditions caused by a snowstorm.

A hiker accused of murdering his girlfriend by abandoning her on a climbing trip to the Grossglockner in 2025 is convicted of gross negligent manslaughter after the woman dies from hypothermia and is sentenced to a five-month suspended prison term.
A 21-year old suspect in the 2024 Vienna terrorism plot is charged with terrorism-related offences.
Four skiers are killed and two others are injured in an avalanche in the Gastein Valley. Another skier later dies in a different avalanche in Bad Hofgastein.
A skier is killed in an avalanche in Weerberg, Tyrol.
